QuestInfo.name: [Pharaoh's Treasure] Explore the Royal Chambers
QuestInfo.0:
#e#b<Pharaoh's Treasure>#k#n

#e[Event Period]#n
07/17/2024 (Wed) 2:00 PM UTC -
08/27/2024 (Tue) 11:59 PM UTC

#e[Event Intro]#n
One day, as a sandstorm covered the Nihal Desert, a massive Pyramid appeared.
On a slate behind that pyramid, the following words were inscribed:
'Whosoever can lay the evil power within to rest, and grant me peaceful slumber, shall lay claim to all the treasure I possess.'
Delve into the dangerous Pyramid and claim the Pharaoh's Treasure!
